visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit indoor terminal with a distinctive checkered ceiling. A young woman with brown hair in pigtail braids, wearing a navy and white striped t-shirt and a short white skirt, walks towards the camera. She is holding a translucent blue water bottle and has a brown plush toy accessory on her bag. In the background, rows of blue terminal seats are filled with people, and a green 'Arrivals' sign is visible. (2) The woman moves to the right and hides behind a thick, beige marble-textured pillar. She then playfully pops her head and upper body out from behind the pillar, smiling and pointing toward the lens. The camera executes a slight zoom-in movement as she leans forward. (3) The scene cuts abruptly to an outdoor beach setting. The same woman is now wearing a black and white striped bikini and a white baseball cap, standing in shallow ocean waves. She is smiling and laughing while splashing water toward the camera with her right hand. The background features a large body of water under a cloudy blue sky with green, forested hills in the distance. The lighting is natural daylight with a cool, cinematic tone.

(3) An energetic K-pop track swells, featuring a bright female vocal singing Korean lyrics interspersed with English phrases like 'Okay' and 'Like that'. The BPM is moderate-fast, with a heavy kick drum pulse on every beat. (4) The song continues with a vibrant, major-key melody and rhythmic synth accompaniment. The vocal delivery remains high-pitched and playful, repeating phrases like 'So cute' and 'Like you' until the track fades out.
